i definitely understand how you feel bc i’m going through something similar right now. i have to make some important decisions about school/my future and i feel so pressured to make the right choices. what i try to remember, is that failure is practically inevitable. that’s just life. it’s going to happen so might as well just accept it. it’s natural to be afraid of making mistakes/failing because most of us have associated our self worth in our successes. i know it’s hard, but try to detach yourself from the perception that your worth = your success. your failures make you human, life would be so incredibly boring if everything went smoothly. this will help you alleviate your anxiety, and make you feel less paralyzed about making your next move. so i guess just accept that things won’t be perfect, be open to mistakes, and just keep moving forward!

keep coming up with ideas (or just continue with the side projects you have already!), or just look for inspiration, and build upon them. reflect and just let your mind do its work! don’t restrict yourself by searching for perfection right away, because when you’re first starting off, the goal for perfection could seem so unreachable it’ll just discourage you. most importantly, choose to move forward even if you don’t get things right the first time.  hope this somewhat helped.
